duration: 1 or 2 hour shifts, Monday to Friday 10am to 5pm, as spaces are available
name: Library volunteers, ages 14 and up (Orange County Public Library)
org: Orange County Public Library, Orange County NC
what_you_do: Help at the main library. You check shelves, get old books ready for the Friends book sale, keep displays full and set up for events.
who_can_apply: Volunteers must be at least 14. You need a set schedule and must complete an application. Adults also complete a background check.
how_to_apply: Fill out a volunteer application. Sign in with the Volunteer Coordinator for each shift. Training is given.
notes: The county document is titled 2024, so confirm shifts and openings with the library before you go. Main branch only: 137 W. Margaret Lane, Hillsborough.
